articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: How the GENIUS Act repriced bitcoin's monetary premium
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Ravi Tanuku on why the GENIUS Act didn't just regulate stablecoins, it repriced Bitcoin's monetary premium. Then, Jesper Johansen on why looped ETH staking no longer needs a lending market.

articles.title: Block kicks off Cash App’s phased stablecoin roll out to its nearly 60 million users
articles.snippet: An individual familiar with the matter told CoinDesk the stablecoin feature was rolled out to 25% of users already and by the end of the week, all users will have access.

articles.title: Mastercard secures New York BitLicense to support stablecoin and digital payment infrastructure
articles.snippet: The payments giant said the approval supports its push into stablecoins and blockchain-based settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: SoFi brings bank-issued stablecoin to 15 million users in crypto push
articles.snippet: The fintech platform says its dollar-backed stablecoin will let members trade, transfer and eventually earn yield through its banking app.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX rejects U.K. sanction allegations, says it refused ruble stablecoin listing
articles.snippet: U.K. authorities sanctioned HTX, saying there were "reasonable grounds to suspect" the crypto exchange was helping Russia by cooperating with ruble stablecoin A7A5.
